ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: The Holocaust Description: Students will explore a variety of approaches to the Holocaust, 1933-1945, examining perpetrators, victims, and bystanders through eyewitness as well as secondary accounts. The course will be global in scale to include Germany, German-occupied Europe, as well as responses in the United States and elsewhere. A final set of readings will focus on the legacy of the Holocaust. The readings will give students the tool to craft, research, and write their own capstone research projects.
